top_signals.title: Ten Cap's Jun Bei Liu: Oil Remains Key Market Risk as Xi and Trump Meet
top_signals.summary: Ten Cap founder Jun Bei Liu views the upcoming Trump-Xi talks as positive for markets, but warns that unresolved oil supply issues pose a far greater near-term threat. Higher energy prices could ignite further inflation and keep interest rates elevated even as equities touch record highs. (Source: Bloomberg)
